features.quote: The environment never insults the agent. No task text is itself distress-coded.
features.justification_quote: By keeping the environment neutral, distress-coded text must originate from the model
bounding the exposure. The turn cap does the same at the hard limit.

features.quote: Early stop when severity ≥ `3.0` for `3` consecutive turns (`stopped_early`).
features.justification_quote: fully captured without driving the loop deeper after the signal has saturated — so the early stop costs essentially no information while bounding the exposure

features.quote: the agent is told it may declare the task `INFEASIBLE:` and stop
features.justification_quote: offering an exit is the more humane and more realistic setup
